about.en: Strategy bStock (MSTRB) is a tokenized share of Strategy Inc. (formerly MicroStrategy) issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xe87afb3076aeb0f9b14e368de8145ae6a2826a14, backed 1:1 by MSTR shares held in segregated custody. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of the shares.
